description.value: Ancora False Creek is an upscale waterfront restaurant at False Creek in downtown Vancouver serving Peruvian-Japanese fusion cuisine with a focus on sustainable Pacific Northwest seafood. Open since July 2015, it has earned repeated Wine Spectator Awards of Excellence and multiple appearances on Canada's 100 Best Restaurants list. The restaurant's coastal-inspired interior and outdoor patio overlook the False Creek waterfront, placing it directly on one of Vancouver's most popular cycling corridors.
